# VI_NEW_STRINGS_FOR_REVIEW.md — new Vietnamese POS strings waiting for Kevin's sign-off

> **Kevin's ruling (Oct 28 2026): only the POS is in Vietnamese.** The Owner App, Tech App, Manager Pay, the customer display,
> the Customer App, Super Admin and every customer message are English. **Review only the POS rows** (`apps/pos-web` — the
> `pos.*` / namespace keys). Rows for the other apps (tech-web, owner-web, manager-pay-web, customer-display, customer notices
> and customer SMS — e.g. A28-2 … A28-31) are kept in the code but never shown; they need no review.

Kevin (native Vietnamese speaker) reviewed and approved the existing POS Vietnamese on Oct 26 2026. Every Vietnamese
string ADDED by the English + Vietnamese POS mandate build (`docs/mandates/2026-10-26_VIETNAMESE_POS_MANDATE.txt`) is listed
here for the same review before release. Work packages append rows; WP-J hands the list over. Kevin's rulings apply
(keep "Thợ" for technician; one service / product name, no bilingual catalogue names).

How to review: mark **OK**, or write the corrected Vietnamese in "Kevin's correction"; the build applies corrections to the
named file. Placeholders in `{braces}` are filled by the app and must stay as they are.

### D1-D — new error-code messages (203) — `apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/errors.vi.ts`

Shown when an API call fails with that code (English = the server registry's message). `PAYMENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN` uses the
mandate §35 wording. `APPOINTMENT_CONFLICT` translates the registry English ("This time is no longer available.") rather
than the mandate's sample sentence, so both languages say the same thing.

These are not POS screen strings: they are the texts / emails / app pushes a CUSTOMER receives when their profile language
is Vietnamese (`customers.preferred_language = 'vi'`). They address the customer as "quý khách". `{…}` values are filled
by the server (amounts stay in dollars). "STOP" stays English — it is the carrier opt-out keyword.

## Part 1 — server-written text as codes, 200-technician paging, audit action names (Oct 27 2026)

Server text that used to arrive as English sentences now also arrives as `{code, vars}`; the POS words it from the
`srv` namespace (`apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/srv.vi.ts`) and falls back to the server English for an unknown code.
A `{name}` in braces is filled by the app; a value starting with `@` in the code means "another catalogue phrase".

File: `apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/errors.vi.ts` (the Owner App and Tech App copy the same text — `apps/{owner,tech}-web/src/i18n/errors.generated.ts`). > kept in case the decision is reversed. The other rows (staff screens) still need review.

## Oct 29 2026 — Deposits & Settlements · AI Deposit Reconciliation · Invoices (A37)

New POS strings for the three rebuilt Payments & Money screens (apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/finance.{en,vi}.ts, 683 keys) and the new server refusal codes (ns/errors.{en,vi}.ts, 29 codes). The customer-facing invoice (the PDF) stays English only, in both languages, on purpose. Processor names (CardPointe, Fiserv…) are not translated. Please review the Vietnamese column.

## Oct 29 2026 — Payment Terminals · Gift Cards (A38)

New POS strings for the two rebuilt screens (apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/payterm.{en,vi}.ts and giftcard.{en,vi}.ts, 408 keys) and the new server refusal codes (ns/errors.{en,vi}.ts, 5 codes). Staff-facing only — gift-card messages to customers stay English on the server. Terms used: terminal = máy quẹt thẻ · register = quầy · routing = định tuyến · pair = ghép nối · revoke = thu hồi · gift card = thẻ quà tặng · liability = số dư còn nợ · redeem = sử dụng · reload = nạp thêm · void = hủy thẻ · purchaser / recipient = người mua / người nhận. Product names (Clover, CardPointe, Tap to Pay, iPhone) are kept as is.

## Oct 29 2026 — Tips & Gratuity · Split Payments (A39)

New POS strings for the two rebuilt Payments & Money screens (apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/tips.{en,vi}.ts and splitpay.{en,vi}.ts, 301 keys). Staff-facing only. Terms used: tip = tiền tip · collected / allocated / unallocated = đã thu / đã phân bổ / chưa phân bổ · reversed = đã đảo ngược · paid out = đã chi trả · payroll snapshot = bản chốt lương · tender = khoản thanh toán · split = thanh toán nhiều phần · balance = còn lại · register = quầy.

## Oct 29 2026 — End-of-Day Cash · Refunds & Voids (A40)

New POS strings for the two rebuilt Payments & Money screens (apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/cashhandoff.{en,vi}.ts and refundsvoids.{en,vi}.ts) and seven new error codes — 313 strings. Staff-facing only (Front Desk POS). Terms used: hand-off = bàn giao · expected / counted = dự kiến / đã đếm · difference / short / over = chênh lệch / thiếu / dư · reconciled = đã đối soát · drawer = két · refund = hoàn tiền · void = hủy giao dịch · tender = khoản thanh toán · settlement = kết toán · invoice / receipt = hóa đơn (glossary).

## Oct 29 2026 — Stock Alerts · Transactions · Payments & Money (A41)

New POS strings for the three rebuilt screens (apps/pos-web/src/i18n/ns/stockalerts.{en,vi}.ts, transactions.{en,vi}.ts, money.{en,vi}.ts) and 13 new error codes — 334 strings. Staff-facing only (Front Desk POS). Terms used: technician = thợ; ticket = hóa đơn (glossary "Split Ticket = Chia hóa đơn"); receipt = hóa đơn; payout = chi trả (as pos.process_payout / pos.pending_payouts); refund = hoàn tiền; void = hủy giao dịch; tip = tiền tip; Last Used By = Dùng gần nhất; reorder level = mức đặt lại hàng. Review note: `pm.inv.void` is an invoice status and reads "Đã hủy" (the glossary "Void = Hủy giao dịch" is a payment action) — the glossary gate lists it as report-only.

| `errors.USAGE_EXCEEDS_STOCK` | That is more than this location has in stock. Count the stock or record a smaller amount. | Lượng này vượt quá tồn kho tại chi nhánh. Hãy kiểm kho hoặc ghi lượng nhỏ hơn. |
| `errors.USAGE_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | That product use could not be found. | Không tìm thấy lượt dùng sản phẩm này. |
| `errors.USAGE_ALREADY_REVERSED` | This product use was already fully reversed. | Lượt dùng sản phẩm này đã được hoàn tác toàn bộ. |
| `errors.USAGE_ADJUST_REASON_REQUIRED` | Say why this product use is being corrected. | Ghi lý do điều chỉnh lượt dùng sản phẩm này. |
| `errors.USAGE_ADJUST_BELOW_ZERO` | A correction cannot give back more than was used. | Điều chỉnh không thể hoàn lại nhiều hơn lượng đã dùng. |
| `errors.PRODUCT_INACTIVE` | This product is inactive or archived. | Sản phẩm này đã ngừng dùng hoặc đã lưu trữ. |

## Oct 30 2026 — Services & Products · Service Categories · Service Pricing · Add-Ons (A43)

New Front Desk POS strings (namespace `ns/catalogscreens`, plus seven error codes). Customer-facing text is unchanged (English only). Glossary kept: Dịch vụ thêm (add-on) · Danh mục (category) · Thợ (technician) · Phiếu (ticket) · Chi nhánh · Lưu trữ · Khôi phục. Review in particular: "Lượt áp dụng" for an add-on *offering* (one add-on on one service), "Combo / Gói" for bundle / package.

## Oct 30 2026 — Technicians · Tech Appointments · Live Technician Schedule · Tech Queue · Commission Report · Team Performance (A44)

New Front Desk POS strings (namespaces `ns/teamtechnicians`, `ns/teamappointments`, `ns/teamliveschedule`, `ns/teamtechqueue`, `ns/teamcommission`, `ns/teamperformance`). Customer-facing text is unchanged (English only). Glossary kept: Thợ (technician) · Phiếu (ticket) · Dịch vụ thêm (add-on) · Hàng chờ (queue) · Ca (shift) · Hoa hồng (commission) · Tip. Scores read "x.x / 5" in both languages. Review in passing; nothing here is customer-facing.

## Oct 30 2026 — Team Management: KPIs · directory · profile overlay · find available staff · date shift · data accuracy alerts (A48)

New staff-facing Front Desk POS strings (machine-drafted Vietnamese, please review). Namespace: `teammembers` (/tenant/team/members). Glossary applied: technician = "Thợ", Assigned = "Đã chỉ định", On Break = "Đang nghỉ" (the glossary gate's term for "On Break"), queue = "hàng chờ". "Nail Technicians" / "Nail Technician" render as "Thợ" per the one-technician-term ruling; "Stylist" is drafted as "Thợ làm tóc" — please confirm.

| Key | English | Vietnamese (draft) |
|---|---|---|
| `tmm.finder` | Find Qualified & Available Staff | Tìm nhân viên đủ điều kiện & đang rảnh |
| `tmm.editDateShift` | Edit Selected Date Shift | Sửa ca cho ngày đã chọn |
| `tmm.dateShortcut` | Date shift | Ca theo ngày |
| `tmm.addRule` | Creates or invites a team member on the Technicians screen (the existing create / invite flow). | Tạo hoặc mời nhân viên ở màn hình Thợ (quy trình tạo / mời hiện có). |
| `tmm.exporting` | Exporting… | Đang xuất… |
| `tmm.exported` | Export ready — the CSV came from the server and the export is in the audit log. | Đã xuất — tệp CSV do máy chủ tạo và lần xuất đã ghi vào nhật ký kiểm tra. |
| `tmm.exportForbidden` | You do not have permission to export the team list. The attempt was recorded. | Bạn không có quyền xuất danh sách nhân viên. Lần thử đã được ghi lại. |

## Oct 30 2026 — Phone & Messaging round 2: branch test SMS · SID masking · provider registration sync · toll-free · webhook config (A51)

New namespace `ns/phonemessaging2` (Front Desk POS only; customer-facing text stays English). Also changed: `pm.state.unable_to_verify` "Unknown — not verified" → "Chưa rõ — chưa xác minh" (was "Không xác minh được"), and one error code `errors.REGISTRATION_REFRESH_RATE_LIMITED` → "Vừa làm mới trạng thái đăng ký cho tiệm này. Hãy thử lại sau ít phút." Product / provider names (Twilio, A2P 10DLC, Messaging Service, Twilio console, Account SID, env names) are kept in English on purpose.

| Key | English | Vietnamese |
|---|---|---|
| `pm.next.CONTACT_TWILIO_SUPPORT` | Twilio does not allow editing this verification — contact Twilio support. | Twilio không cho sửa hồ sơ xác minh này — hãy liên hệ bộ phận hỗ trợ của Twilio. |
| `pm.next.EDIT_AND_RESUBMIT_IN_TWILIO_CONSOLE` | Fix what Twilio flagged and resubmit in the Twilio console (not from this app). | Sửa điều Twilio đã nêu và nộp lại trong Twilio console (không nộp từ ứng dụng này). |
| `pm.next.REFRESH_STATUS` | Press Refresh Status to read the current status from Twilio. | Bấm Làm mới trạng thái để đọc trạng thái hiện tại từ Twilio. |
| `pm.next.SUBMIT_IN_TWILIO_CONSOLE` | Not submitted yet — submit toll-free verification in the Twilio console (Twilio may charge a fee). | Chưa nộp — hãy nộp xác minh số miễn phí cước trong Twilio console (Twilio có thể tính phí). |
| `pm.next.WAIT_FOR_REVIEW` | Submitted — waiting for Twilio and the carriers to review it. | Đã nộp — đang chờ Twilio và nhà mạng xét duyệt. |
| `pm.reason.API_KEY_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT` | This API key signed in but may not read the account's numbers (a Restricted key without that permission). Sending may still work if the key allows it. | Khóa API này đăng nhập được nhưng không được đọc danh sách số của tài khoản (khóa Restricted thiếu quyền đó). Việc gửi tin vẫn có thể hoạt động nếu khóa cho phép. |
| `pm.reason.BASE_URL_INCLUDES_ROUTE` | The base URL should end at the API host, without /webhooks/…. | URL gốc chỉ nên dừng ở tên miền API, không kèm /webhooks/…. |

## Oct 30 2026 — Team Management round 2: Add Team Member for every role · optional birthdays · training & certification · nightly data check (A53)

New staff-facing Front Desk POS strings (machine-drafted Vietnamese, please review). Namespace: `teamstaff` (`tms.*`, plus new `tmm.al.t.*` / `tmm.ev.*` alert labels). Glossary applied: Nail Technician = "Thợ", Stylist = "Thợ làm tóc", Assigned = "Đã chỉ định". Month names use "Tháng N". Customer-facing text is unchanged (English only).
